calls.title: GrowthBook Demo for Moonrail
calls.summary: The company discussed its growth strategy, emphasizing Dual.com, which targets the crypto casino sector with low House Edge games to enhance user acquisition and conversion. The legacy brand, csgoempire.com, continues to serve a steady user base but is seen as limited in growth potential. A crucial focus is on implementing web experimentation, led by VP of Data, Fraser Gray, and his small data team, aiming to employ feature flagging and variant testing. Conversion metrics from sign-up to first deposit were highlighted as key indicators of success, with the intent to use Bayesian methods for analysis. The team is evaluating GrowthBook for experimentation features, emphasizing self-hosted solutions for data control. A quick decision on this evaluation is anticipated by the end of March, with follow-up technical discussions planned.
calls.keywords: Moonrail, GrowthBook, Web Experimentation, Bayesian Statistics, Feature Flags, Self-hosted Enterprise
